suites.command: cargo test -p oms-node --lib --test reconciler --test record_schema --test alerts --test holds_node --test liveness --test monitor_node --test bybit_recorded
suites.name: node-unit
suites.what: queues, histogram, Hyperliquid signing vectors and message translation; the reconciler task at its ports (pace of the margin, venue-setting and account-mode queries); the record schema (old journals replay, recovery from disk); the direct alerts in-process (conditions, grace, repeat, fatal, durable only; loopback fake Telegram); the holds of C-HOLD through oms-node and simvenue processes (kill marker, clear-hold, the watcher's inputs); strategy liveness through oms-node and simvenue processes (C-LIVE: the last close, silence, a second connection, hello after a loss); the monitoring gate through oms-node and simvenue processes (C-LIVE part 2: monitor.sock, heartbeats, stage 2 at the venue, a restart); the Bybit gateway on answers recorded from the real testnet (loopback fake serving the recorded bodies)

suites.name: alert
suites.what: direct Telegram alerts (alert-direct): delivery rules, repeat rule, Telegram failing since, the second channel and its Telegram-down notice; loopback fakes only

suites.name: watcher
suites.what: the independent watcher (U19a): its own journal reader at its failure boundaries (cap, rotation, damage, latched errors), known events against the C-TAIL table, decimals, Base32Pair, its journal state by the rows of the C-TAIL table; its own Bybit signer and client against a loopback fake on a manual clock (answer classes, never-retried key rejections, the 403 pause, the request guard) and its metrics registry and VM import client; its own Telegram sender against a loopback fake (the alert rules, the two routes, the flush pace on a manual clock, the shutdown flush); its config file and credentials file (every field and refusal, mainnet confirmation, owner and mode); its start checks and IP recheck as sans-IO steps on a manual clock (query-api rules, days left, public IP, settle coin, retries, the key stop); the sans-IO check engine, W1 and W2 on an in-process model venue and a manual clock (scheduler, status per round, journal errors, deadlines, the two-round rule, W1 paging and kinds, W2 positions with their change times and deferral); the resend rule of watcher_mismatch on the engine rig, the admin.sock and monitor.sock clients against fake sockets, and the runtime against loopback fakes (one end-to-end test in real time; status wait, IP recheck, key rejection, refusal, shutdown); conformance against oms-core and oms-journal (the sets after every record of scenarios with every event kind)
